title: Goodnight Forest 🦔 Calm Bedtime Story with Luna the Owl
intro: Hello, little one. I'm Luna, the sleepy owl. Welcome back to Moonbeam Bedtime.
Tonight, we'll say goodnight to the sleepy friends of the forest.
First, let's take a slow, deep breath together. Breathe in, and breathe out.
Get cozy, snuggle in under your blanket, and listen softly.
Are you ready? Let's begin our story.

lines: Here's a little clue: she has long legs, big soft ears, and little white spots on her back. Who could it be?
This is Deer. Can you whisper deer? Nice and soft.
A baby deer is called a fawn, and she has soft white spots.
Her spots help her rest quietly in the tall, shady grass.
Can you make big deer ears with your hands, and listen very quietly?
What do we call a baby deer?
A fawn. A sweet, spotted little fawn.
Let's say it softly together: Deer.
One more time, very quietly, like a little whisper: Deer.
Fawn folds her long legs and lies down in the soft, cool grass.
Here's a little clue: he's orange, with pointy ears and a big, bushy tail. Who could it be?
This is Fox. Can you whisper fox? Nice and soft.
Foxes have big, fluffy tails, as soft as a scarf.
When it's chilly, a fox curls up and wraps his tail around him like a warm blanket.
Can you wrap your arms around yourself, like a cozy fox tail? Mmm, so warm.
What does a fox use like a blanket?
His big, bushy tail. Soft and warm.
Let's say it softly together: Fox.
One more time, very quietly, like a little whisper: Fox.
Fox tucks his nose under his tail and lets out a slow, sleepy sigh.
Here's a little clue: she's small and round, and her back is covered in little spikes. Who could it be?
This is Hedgehog. Can you whisper hedgehog? Nice and soft.
The little spikes on a hedgehog's back are called spines.
To feel cozy, a hedgehog can curl up into a round, spiky ball.
Can you curl up small like a hedgehog? Tuck in your chin, and breathe slowly.
What are a hedgehog's spikes called?
Spines. Lots and lots of little spines.
Let's say it softly together: Hedgehog.
One more time, very quietly, like a little whisper: Hedgehog.
Hedgehog snuggles into her soft nest of crunchy leaves.
Here's a little clue: he has a big curly tail, and he loves to collect nuts. Who could it be?
This is Squirrel. Can you whisper squirrel? Nice and soft.
Squirrels hide nuts in the ground, so they have snacks for winter.
They sleep in round, leafy nests high up in the trees.
Can you pretend to hold a little acorn, and hug it gently?
In a leafy nest, high up in a tree.
Let's say it softly together: Squirrel.
One more time, very quietly, like a little whisper: Squirrel.
Squirrel curls his fluffy tail over his head like a cozy hat.
Here's a little clue: she has a dark mask around her eyes and stripes on her tail. Who could it be?
This is Raccoon. Can you whisper raccoon? Nice and soft.
Raccoons have a mask of dark fur around their eyes.
Their little front paws can feel things very, very well.
Can you wiggle your fingers softly, like little raccoon paws?
Around her eyes. A soft, furry mask.
Let's say it softly together: Raccoon.
One more time, very quietly, like a little whisper: Raccoon.
Raccoon likes the quiet night, so she waves a gentle hello to the moon.

recap: Let's remember all of our sleepy friends.
outro: Goodnight, Deer, Fox, Hedgehog, Squirrel, and Raccoon. Now close your eyes, and dream sweet, gentle dreams.
Goodnight, little one. Luna loves you. Sleep tight.
